svg.title: AIcoach — Upload on phone (tray and sheets)
svg.text: At the range, one sheet at a time

text.tspan: The coach thread is the base layer. The clip, the evidence and the chat slide up over it as bottom sheets, so
one thing is in front at a time and every action stays in thumb reach.
